headline: Adopted consent agenda ratifying assistant election officials for August 11, 2026 State Primary Election
summary: The Board of Civil Authority adopted the consent agenda, which included a resolution ratifying the appointment of assistant election officials for the August 11, 2026 State Primary Election. The meeting lasted from 7:53 pm to 7:53 pm.
decisions: Adopted the consent agenda, including ratifying the appointment of assistant election officials for the August 11, 2026 State Primary Election.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion made by City Council President Traverse, seconded by Councilor Carpenter, to adopt the consent agenda and take the actions indicated. Motion passed unanimously.
